evidence.reason: Current contract item 2 requires machine mode: with `--json`, stderr stays empty and an error with no result emits one `{ error: … }` JSON object on stdout, with the required exit code. `prepare-host.py` has no `--json` flag, so line 853 rejects it before overlay load or dispatch; its top-level failure path at 885–887 raises `SystemExit(str(exc))`, leaving stdout empty and writing the message to stderr. Its success path also prints narration unconditionally at 879. This is an implementation gap in the existing CLI output contract, not a new protection scope; the fix is additive and routine.
